text:
Ava Lin: FYI — three invoices got post-run corrections this morning. Token tallies showed up late because the ingress-aggregator service scaled to zero during a maintenance window and backlog delivery was delayed. Need owners for RCA, billing corrections, and follow-up actions.

Rohit Desai: Which customers and timeframe? I can take the infra side.

Ava Lin: Customers: neon-analytics, paylance, mapwise. Delay window ~2026-06-11 01:20-01:50 UTC. Adjustments queued: ADJ-9320, ADJ-9321, ADJ-9322. Artifacts: s3://redwood-metering/incidents/2026-06-11/manifest.csv

Marta Gomez: I can own invoice corrections + customer comms. Draft notice: "We observed delayed processing of usage events due to an ingress aggregator scaling gap during maintenance. Counts have been reconciled and credits applied (ADJ IDs). We're updating autoscaling settings and monitoring to avoid recurrence." Thoughts?

billing-bot: Adjustments queued: ADJ-9320 ADJ-9321 ADJ-9322 status=pending

Rohit Desai: Initial triage: HPA scaled ingress-aggregator to 0 because K8s liveness probe returned 502 briefly during node drain. Backlog was delivered when replica came up ~25m later. Logs from aggregator-controller: 
```
2026-06-11T01:19:12Z WARN probe liveness failed status=502 path=/healthz
2026-06-11T01:19:20Z INFO hpa scaling replica_count=0 -> reason=cpu_below_threshold
2026-06-11T01:44:30Z INFO pod aggregator-0 started processing backlog count=12432
```
Short mitigation: pin minReplicas=1 for ingress-aggregator HPA and adjust liveness probe grace period during maintenance windows. I'll open a PR to infra config.

Ava Lin: Can you also add an alert for backlog delivery delay > 10m to route to #eng-infra and notify oncall? We should treat delayed token ingestion as paging severity if it's causing billing adjustments.

Rohit Desai: Will add alert rule `IngressAggregatorBacklogDelay` and a dashboard tile. Also propose a post-deploy check that ensures minReplicas respected during node drains.

Marta Gomez: Timeline suggestion:
- Rohit: RCA + infra PR to pin minReplicas and adjust probe by 2026-06-15
- Rohit: Alert + dashboard by 2026-06-13
- Marta: Process invoice corrections & customer emails by 2026-06-12 (before next billing run)
- Postmortem doc + attach S3 artifacts (owner: Rohit + Ava) by 2026-06-18

billing-bot: Adjustment processed: ADJ-9320 status=completed 2026-06-11T10:02:01Z

Ava Lin: Added PM-845 to tracker and linked S3 export. Please attach logs and the HPA config diff. Also run a 90-day recurrence scan SQL and paste results in the postmortem.

Rohit Desai: SQL I ran: `SELECT date_trunc('week', ingested_at) wk, count(*) delayed FROM metering.events WHERE processed_at - ingested_at > interval '10 minutes' GROUP BY wk ORDER BY wk DESC LIMIT 12;` Found 1 similar event in last 90 days during a maintenance window. I'll include results in the RCA.

Marta Gomez: Sending customer emails now. Template saved at /docs/billing/late-ingest-templates/aggregator-scaling.md. I'll cc support and billing-ops.

Ava Lin: Good. Track customer replies here and update PM-845. Monitor next two invoice cycles to confirm fix.
